input.quote: commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000
input.rationale: Section 18 matches our preferred limits (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' compensation) for the term plus one year, with certificates on request and confirmation in Section 18.2 that insurance does not limit Vendor's liability.

input.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 is a multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right — expressly walk-away territory — and it contradicts Section 12.3's acknowledgement that no minimum-volume commitment has been made. Narrowed to the fallback: commitment limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, with a true-up instead of a penalty.

input.quote: On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period.
input.rationale: Section 10 deals only with access wind-down, Deliverable delivery and refunds; there is no transition-assistance obligation and no obligation to return or export Customer Data in a usable format (Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to a non-existent Section 11). For a hosted-services vendor this absence is a deviation, so we inserted the standard transition, data-return within 30 days and certified-deletion paragraph.
